name: Build an AI Second Brain with Telegram, OpenAI & Notion — V4

parameters.content:
## Build an AI Second Brain with Telegram, OpenAI & Notion

Capture links, images, videos, and ideas from Telegram. AI extracts and organizes useful information into a structured Notion Inbox.

### How it works
- **Capture:** Receive content through Telegram.
- **Extract:** Process Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, webpages, images, and text.
- **Analyze:** Generate an English title, summary, key insights, and up to 3 actionable tasks.
- **Save:** Create a categorized Notion page with original source references.
- **Reply:** Send a Telegram confirmation or error message.

### Setup
- Connect Telegram, OpenAI, Apify, and Notion credentials.
- Configure the authorized Telegram user.
- Set the Notion database and property mappings.
- Test supported sources before activation.

### Customization
- **AI Prompt:** Adjust summaries, categories, and task generation.
- **Output Parser:** Modify structured output fields.
- **Notion Mapping:** Customize page properties and formatting.
- **Source Processing:** Adjust extraction rules and limits.

### Requirements
- Telegram Bot
- OpenAI API
- Apify API
- Notion integration and database access

### Notes
- One message = one entry; only the first URL is processed.
- Output is always in English.
- Instagram: up to 20 carousel images.
- Telegram images: maximum 10 MB.
- TikTok audio: maximum 300 seconds.
- YouTube: long transcripts may be sampled.
- Video visuals and protected webpages are not fully supported.
- No persistent duplicate detection.
- Notion saves are confirmed only after successful creation.

**Support & customization:** [info@paoloronco.it](mailto:info@paoloronco.it) · [paoloronco.it](https://paoloronco.it).

nodes.name: Overview — How it works and setup

parameters.content:
## Telegram intake & routing

Classify authorized messages, captions, links and images. Help and unsupported inputs go straight to the reply section; recognized sources follow their dedicated lane.

## Instagram URL validation

Accept public Reel and /p/ post URLs. Reels go to the shared transcription lane. Photo/carousel posts fetch their media first; video posts still use transcription. Invalid links avoid paid calls.

## Reel & TikTok video transcription

Run the source-specific Apify actor, check completion, then validate the transcript. A pending run gets one additional check; failed, timed-out or empty results go to the reply section. Video visuals are not analyzed.

## Web

Read public static HTML and extract useful page text. Redirected, dynamic or login-only pages may require pasted text or a screenshot. Continue only when usable content is available.

## Image / screenshot

Download the largest Telegram photo or image document and extract visible information with Vision. Preserve uncertainty and normalize the text for shared analysis. Download or Vision errors go to the reply section.

## Ideas / fallback

Keep free-form messages, rough notes and incomplete ideas as the original source. Shared analysis clarifies the wording in English without inventing context, commitments or tasks.

## Source validation

Instagram image posts, web, image and idea lanes converge here. Usable text continues to shared analysis; extraction failures go to the reply section.

## Concise English analysis

Create a specific title, 25–45-word summary and up to three grounded tasks. Add at most 40 extra words only when useful. The structured parser and completeness check guard the Notion write.

## Notion Inbox

Save the capture and task checkboxes.  
Confirm only after Notion returns a page ID.

## Telegram replies & failures

Converge successful saves, help, invalid inputs and handled errors here. Confirm a save only after Notion returns a page ID; otherwise explain the problem and the next step in English.

parameters.content:
## Instagram photos & carousels

Fetch one public post with Apify Instagram Scraper. Preserve slide order and read up to 20 images with Vision, including visible text and useful visual context. Combine extracted text with the caption in the shared English analysis; save one Notion entry for the whole post.

No speech is required. Music is ignored; video slides contribute previews only. Single video posts use the existing transcript lane. Missing images or Vision failures use a sufficiently informative caption with an explicit limitation; otherwise return a helpful failure.

Uses the existing Apify and OpenAI credentials. Temporary CDN links are used immediately. Actor timeout: 180 seconds; maximum actor charge: USD 1 per run. OCR and slide count limitations remain visible in the saved source notes.

## YouTube — videos & Shorts

Accepts youtube.com/watch, /shorts, /live, /embed and youtu.be links (extra parameters are ignored). Start the Apify YouTube Transcript actor: YouTube captions first, AI speech-to-text only when a video has no captions. Re-check every ~55 seconds for up to about 10 minutes so long videos can finish, then validate and clean the transcript.

Every failure (Apify error, failed run, timeout, empty transcript) follows a single path to the reply section, which shows the error code and a short detail. Transcripts above ~120,000 characters are sampled evenly across the whole video. The result joins the shared flow at Source — Ready for Analysis? → AI → Notion Inbox → Telegram reply. Playlists and channels are rejected with a hint.

Uses the existing Apify credential. Actor timeout: 600 seconds; maximum actor charge: USD 1 per run. Video visuals and on-screen text are not analyzed.

nodes.name: YouTube — Start Transcript Run
nodes.notes: Do not retry the paid actor automatically. An error continues as an item with an error field and is handled by YouTube — Run Started?. YouTube captions first; AI speech-to-text only when a video has none.

nodes.name: YouTube — Wait & Re-check Run
nodes.notes: Long-poll the Apify run for up to 55 seconds. Loops back through YouTube — Keep Waiting? until the run finishes or the wait limit (about 10 minutes) is reached.
